title: No stated legal basis for processing
description: The policy describes collecting and using personal data of people in the EU/EEA/UK but never says on what legal ground (for example consent, contract, legitimate interests, legal obligation). Do not flag if any legal basis is named, even briefly.

title: Transfers outside the EU/EEA without named safeguards
description: Data of EU/EEA/UK users is sent to countries outside the EU/EEA (for example the US) and the policy names no transfer mechanism such as standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules or an adequacy decision. Do not flag if a mechanism is named.

title: No commitment to report data breaches
description: The policy says nothing about notifying authorities or users after a data breach, or explicitly disclaims any duty to notify. Do not flag if a breach notification process is described.
